items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: Lena Horne was the ingenue, and what's the boy -- oh, what's his name? Gates or Yates or something. He was in Brown Sugar.

ctx.x: So when Jimmy went to the Cotton Club right after Duke left, my man asked him if he had gotten anybody to arrange, so he said there was a boy downtown there at the Lafayette, and they called me up and I went up there and I arranged two numbers -- Here Goes a Fool in Love, and I'm Going To Love You as Long as I Live.
Lena Horne was the ingenue, and what's the boy -- oh, what's his name? Gates or Yates or something. He was in Brown Sugar.
